title: 07/23 RET Asset Identifiers
author: fortetroy
body:
> Enter the corresponding unique asset ID specified in the CSP's Integrated Inventory Workbook (IIW). This is a unique string associated with the asset; it could be an IP address or any arbitrary naming scheme. Include the complete identifier name (no short hand). If multiple assets are affected, separate each by a new line (Alt+Enter).

Does this mean that assets can be grouped into one RET/POAM ID or does this require a separate RET/POAM ID per CVE per asset?

What is the desired approach to support FedRAMP processing of this document?
